reason: NONE. What I noticed first was $29.99 and 2 capsules in every sachet. I hate swallowing pills, and two a day is already more than I want. I paid about half that for a bottle of 8 forms of magnesium in a flash sale and it lasted me 3 months, and this box is gone in 30 days.
objection: $29.99 for one month is roughly double what I paid for a bottle that lasts 3 months, and it is capsules, 2 at a time, when I would rather have a gummy or a drink mix. Nothing says how big the capsules are.
would_change_my_mind: A drink mix or gummy version, or a price around $15 to $18 for the 30 days.
